newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market falls, high caps tumble.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market falls, high caps tumble.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market declined on Tuesday for the first time in two weeks, signalling an end to a prolonged bullish mood.

Traders said blue chips were too expensive and investors did not want to buy further. But they started to focus on some atractive smaller stocks, which could become more liquid in future. They forecast further falls in coming days.
Three independent indices which measure the performance of Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market fell on Tuesday.

The VAB-RA all-share index, computed by Vanguard securities, lost two percent from Monday to 5,751.9 points and BIG-OTC, compiled by Bucharest Investment Group, fell by 3.72 percent to 4,538.6. Creditanstalt Securities' CAS-RQ slipped by 3.35 percent to 1,032 points.
On Tuesday, oil refineries and cement makers posted the biggest losses.
Arpechim oil refinery, a market star over the past months, lost 13,000 lei and closed at 38,000. Petrobrazi, another refinery in high demand in recent weeks ended 4,000 lei weaker at 52,000.
Cement maker Romcim, one of the best perfomers on the OTC market, lost 10,000 lei to close at 122,000. Steel mill Sidex went down by 3,000 lei and closed at 20,000.
Overall turnover fell to 28.1 billion lei from 31.9 billion on Monday.
